cat > /app/start_windows311.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# QEMU configuration for Windows 3.11
QEMU_BINARY="/usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64"
DISK_IMAGE="/app/isos/win311.img"
SNAPSHOT_MODE="-snapshot"
VNC_DISPLAY=":1"
QMP_TCP="127.0.0.1:4444"

# Start QEMU with:
# - Snapshot mode to keep image immutable
# - VNC display :1 (port 5901)
# - QMP TCP interface for programmatic control
# - Serial port for keyboard input
# - No GUI display (we use VNC)

$QEMU_BINARY \
  -m 32M \
  -cpu 486 \
  -vga std \
  -drive file=$DISK_IMAGE,if=ide,media=disk $SNAPSHOT_MODE \
  -display vnc=$VNC_DISPLAY \
  -qmp tcp:$QMP_TCP,server,nowait \
  -serial mon:stdio \
  -daemonize

echo "QEMU started with VNC on :1 and QMP on 4444"
EOF
chmod +x /app/start_windows311.sh

cat > /app/start_windows311.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# QEMU configuration for Windows 3.11
QEMU_BINARY="/usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64"
DISK_IMAGE="/app/isos/win311.img"
SNAPSHOT_MODE="-snapshot"
VNC_DISPLAY=":1"
QMP_UNIX="/tmp/qemu-qmp.sock"

# Start QEMU with:
# - Snapshot mode to keep image immutable
# - VNC display :1 (port 5901)
# - QMP Unix socket for programmatic control
# - Serial port for keyboard input

$QEMU_BINARY \
  -m 32M \
  -cpu 486 \
  -vga std \
  -drive file=$DISK_IMAGE,if=ide,media=disk $SNAPSHOT_MODE \
  -display vnc=$VNC_DISPLAY \
  -qmp unix:$QMP_UNIX,server,nowait \
  -serial null \
  -daemonize

echo "QEMU started with VNC on :1 and QMP on $QMP_UNIX"
EOF
chmod +x /app/start_windows311.sh
